*** Add File: select_voice.py
+import os
+import sys
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+
+
+OPENAI_VOICES = ["alloy", "echo", "fable", "onyx", "nova", "shimmer"]
+
+
+def select_voice(target_locale: str, available_voices=None) -> str:
+    available_voices = available_voices or OPENAI_VOICES
+    locale = (target_locale or "").strip().lower()
+    if locale.startswith(("en", "en-")):
+        preferred = ["alloy", "nova", "echo"]
+    elif locale.startswith(("es", "es-")):
+        preferred = ["nova", "alloy", "shimmer"]
+    elif locale.startswith(("fr", "fr-")):
+        preferred = ["shimmer", "nova", "alloy"]
+    elif locale.startswith(("de", "de-")):
+        preferred = ["onyx", "alloy", "echo"]
+    elif locale.startswith(("ja", "ja-")):
+        preferred = ["shimmer", "nova", "echo"]
+    else:
+        preferred = ["alloy", "nova", "echo"]
+    for voice in preferred:
+        if voice in available_voices:
+            return voice
+    return available_voices[0] if available_voices else "alloy"
+
+
+def list_openai_tts_voices() -> list[str]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", "").strip()
+    if not api_key:
+        return OPENAI_VOICES[:]
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech",
+        data=urllib.parse.urlencode({"model": "gpt-4o-mini-tts", "input": "test", "voice": "alloy"}).encode(),
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
+        method="POST",
+    )
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10):
+            pass
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError:
+        pass
+    except urllib.error.URLError:
+        pass
+    return OPENAI_VOICES[:]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        print("Usage: python select_voice.py <locale> [--list]")
+        return 2
+    locale = sys.argv[1]
+    voices = list_openai_tts_voices()
+    if len(sys.argv) > 2 and sys.argv[2] == "--list":
+        print("\n".join(voices))
+        return 0
+    print(select_voice(locale, voices))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch

+import os
+import requests
+
+
+def synthesize_ssml(ssml: str, output_path: str, voice: str = "en-US-JennyNeural", prosody_rate: str = "0%", prosody_pitch: str = "0%") -> None:
+    subscription_key = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"]
+    region = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"]
+    endpoint = f"https://{region}.tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1"
+    headers = {
+        "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": subscription_key,
+        "Content-Type": "application/ssml+xml",
+        "X-Microsoft-OutputFormat": "riff-24khz-16bit-mono-pcm",
+        "User-Agent": "synthesize_ssml.py",
+    }
+    payload = f'<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="{voice}"><prosody rate="{prosody_rate}" pitch="{prosody_pitch}">{ssml}</prosody></voice></speak>'
+    response = requests.post(endpoint, headers=headers, data=payload.encode("utf-8"), timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
+        f.write(response.content)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: synthesize_ssml.py <ssml_text> <output_path>")
+    synthesize_ssml(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Optional
+
+from elevenlabs.client import ElevenLabs
+
+
+def synthesize_text(text: str, voice: Optional[str] = None, model: str = "eleven_turbo_v2_5") -> bytes:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ELEVENLABS_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is required")
+    client = ElevenLabs(api_key=api_key)
+    voice_id = voice or os.environ.get("ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID", "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM")
+    audio = client.text_to_speech.convert(text=text, voice_id=voice_id, model_id=model)
+    if isinstance(audio, (bytes, bytearray)):
+        return bytes(audio)
+    return b"".join(chunk for chunk in audio)
